items.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
items.text: PresentationParameters.RenderTargetUsage is stored, cloned and exposed but never consulted when SetRenderTargets returns to the back buffer.

items.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
items.text: Vulkan multi-target render passes begin every colour attachment with LOAD_OP_CLEAR from an undefined layout (except split continuations), so a PreserveContents/PlatformContents target loses its contents when bound as part of an MRT set.

items.section: Two SetData paths, and why GetData can hide a failed upload
items.text: Canvas and FreeDirect texture renderers throw for any Texture2D mip level above 0.

items.section: A shared readback hole in the options-taking path
items.text: Dynamic*Buffer SetData(..., SetDataOptions) did not update the CPU shadow, so GetData on a fresh BufferUsage::None buffer threw ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

items.section: Render targets: a once-sharp per-renderer divergence, mostly closed since
items.text: RenderTargetCube lacks the bound-target disposal guard that RenderTarget2D has.

items.section: RenderTargetUsage: three values, more than three behaviors
items.text: SetRenderTargets performs native and state work for an identical repeated binding instead of returning early.
EasyGL skips outgoing-face finalisation (resolve, mip generation) when switching directly between faces of the same RenderTargetCube.
Vulkan RenderTargetCube sampling after rendering returned black (clear-only target not recorded; render-all-faces-then-sample).
HEADLESS validates and traces TextureCube uploads but stores nothing, so cube SetData throws NotSupportedException and cube content paths cannot be exercised on HEADLESS.
Vulkan created Texture2D images as R8G8B8A8_SRGB and preferred an sRGB swapchain (mid-grey 128 read as 188 on untextured output).
Disposing an untracked Texture2D/TextureCube value copy (for example by its destructor) raises GraphicsDevice.ResourceDestroyed although no ResourceCreated was raised for it.
DIRECTX9 writes D3DSAMP_MAXANISOTROPY without checking D3DCAPS9::MaxAnisotropy and reports AnisotropicFiltering through the inherited default.
SDL_GPU stores the requested MaxAnisotropy but never puts it in a sampler-cache key; Software ignores sampler values.
METAL throws NotSupportedException for non-default MaxMipLevel/MipMapLevelOfDetailBias, partial colour-write masks and a non-default MultiSampleMask.
SDL_GPU cannot honour BlendState.MultiSampleMask; SDL documents the sample-mask fields as reserved.
EasyGL on GLES/WebGL contexts without GL_NV_polygon_mode or WEBGL_polygon_mode refuses wireframe triangle draws.
CANVAS and FREEDIRECT never apply a scissor rectangle; SDL_RENDERER ignores ScissorTestEnable and always clips to the rectangle.
Vulkan RasterizerState.DepthBias fails at DepthBias = -1e6.
Changing GraphicsDevice.ReferenceStencil without reassigning the DepthStencilState is ineffective on EasyGL (no SetReferenceStencil override).

items.section: The value surface is broader than the binding bridge
items.text: GraphicsDevice.MultiSampleMask, RasterizerState.MultiSampleAntiAlias and SamplerState.AddressW never reach the renderer.
EasyGL maps plain Point/Linear to non-mipmapped filters, so a real mip chain is never used under the default filter.

CNA state objects follow XNA's freeze-on-bind rule (mutation after assignment throws), a deliberate divergence from FNA's mutable states; code written for value semantics must configure before assigning.
